mapper.select: with recursive up as ( select h.node_id, h.parent_id, 0 as d from mst_equip_hier h where h.node_id = #{nodeId} union all select p.node_id, p.parent_id, u.d + 1 from up u join mst_equip_hier p on p.node_id = u.parent_id where u.d < 20 ), owner as ( select u.node_id from up u where exists (select 1 from wms_loc_class_allow a where a.node_id = u.node_id and a.use_yn = 'Y') order by u.d limit 1 ) select a.item_class_id as class_id, k.class_cd, k.class_nm, a.node_id as owner_node_id from owner o join wms_loc_class_allow a on a.node_id = o.node_id and a.use_yn = 'Y' join mst_item_class k on k.class_id = a.item_class_id order by k.class_cd
select i.item_cd, i.item_class_id as class_id, k.class_cd from mst_item i left join mst_item_class k on k.class_id = i.item_class_id where i.item_id = #{itemId}
select h.node_cd from mst_equip_hier h where h.node_id = #{nodeId}
select a.item_class_id from wms_loc_class_allow a where a.node_id = #{nodeId} and a.use_yn = 'Y' order by a.item_class_id
select a.allow_id, a.item_class_id as class_id, a.use_yn from wms_loc_class_allow a where a.node_id = #{nodeId} order by a.allow_id for update
select k.class_id, k.class_cd, k.class_nm from mst_item_class k where k.use_yn = 'Y' order by k.sort_no, k.class_cd
mapper.insert: insert into wms_loc_class_allow (comp_cd, node_id, item_class_id, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{nodeId}, #{classId}, #{by}, #{by})
